text: And whoever seeks a religion other than Islam, which is submission to Allah through tawhid (monotheism) and compliance with Him through obedience and servitude, and to His Messenger, the final Prophet Muhammad, peace be upon him, through faith in him, following him, and loving him outwardly and inwardly, it will never be accepted from him, and in the Hereafter he will be among the losers who have deprived themselves of their share.
